# Data Munging with Perl

> Second edition of Dave Cross's practical guide to data recognition, parsing,
> transformation and filtering in Perl. Published on 21 November 2026 as a
> paperback and Kindle ebook from Amazon, and as a DRM-free PDF and EPUB from
> Leanpub. Every example has been run and checked on Perl 5.36 to 5.44.

## Links
- [Buy the paperback on Amazon](https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/1065495714)
- [Buy the PDF and EPUB on Leanpub](https://leanpub.com/datamungingwithperl)
- [Example code and errata reports](https://perlschool.com/books/data-munging/)
- [Author: Dave Cross](https://davecross.co.uk/)
- [Perl Hacks blog](https://perlhacks.com/)
